capabilityAdminIntro: Inspect each decision dimension independently, then apply a versioned policy override with a recorded reason.
capabilityPlatformIntro: Global operator controls are the absolute ceiling for every organization, workspace, model, and request.
capabilityPlatformReadOnly: This layer is read-only in Romeo. Change deployment policy through the operator-controlled environment and redeploy; tenant administrators cannot override it.
capabilityScopeDescription: Policy is inherited through organization, workspace, published agent version, mutable agent, groups, and user. Any deny remains absolute.
capabilityEvaluationWorkspaceDescription: Choose the exact workspace ceiling used to explain this group or user policy. The assignment remains organization-wide.
capabilityImageGenerationDescription: Create governed image artifacts through an installed compatible provider and model.
capabilityImageGenerationRemediation: Verify the image provider, model support, access, and effective policy limits.
capabilityVoiceProcessingDescription: Transcribe and synthesize governed audio through the configured voice provider.
capabilityVoiceProcessingRemediation: Verify voice access, provider configuration, and organization policy.
capabilityWebRetrievalDescription: Search and retrieve public web sources through governed network controls.
capabilityWebRetrievalRemediation: Verify retrieval access, credentials, egress policy, and organization limits.
capabilityContentFirewallDescription: Scan streamed and stored model output before it is persisted or shown.
capabilityContentFirewallRemediation: Review detector policy, fail-closed posture, and output buffering mode.
capabilityKnowledgeAclDescription: Prefilter enterprise knowledge by source ACLs before ranking.
capabilityKnowledgeAclRemediation: Confirm connector ACL sync, identity mapping, and freshness.
capabilityRealtimeVoiceDescription: Authenticated duplex voice sessions through a separately installed gateway.
capabilityRealtimeVoiceRemediation: Install the realtime gateway or use batch speech-to-text and text-to-speech.
capabilityImageEditingDescription: Edit, mask, and vary existing images through governed file-reference jobs.
capabilityImageEditingRemediation: Confirm image capability, source file readiness, and edit policy.
capabilitySecureComputeDescription: Run isolated jobs on a separately installed Kata runtime.
capabilitySecureComputeRemediation: Install the compute runtime. Application hosts never execute untrusted code.
capabilityMultiModelCompareDescription: Fan out one prompt to authorized models with aggregate preflight and cost caps.
capabilityMultiModelCompareRemediation: Authorize every child model and confirm the compare capability is enabled.
capabilityTenantEncryptionDescription: Customer-held wrapping keys for tenant data. Platform keys are never substituted.
capabilityTenantEncryptionRemediation: Configure a customer KMS wrapping key and keep it available.
capabilityDataExportDescription: Authorized, checkpointed exports of tenant data.
capabilityDataExportRemediation: Confirm export authorization, dual approval, and destination policy.
capabilityLockedInheritance: This setting is locked by a higher policy layer.
capabilityApprovalRequired: High-risk changes require a second approver.
capabilityVoiceUsesOrganizationPolicy: Voice processing has no additional numeric limits in this policy version. Provider, content, storage, and quota controls still apply.
capabilityOrganizationOnly: This capability is controlled at the organization layer. Workspace administrators can inspect the effective decision but cannot override it.
capabilityExpiryDescription: Leave blank for no expiry. Expiring overrides automatically return to the inherited policy.
capabilityExpiryInvalid: Choose a future expiry time or leave this field blank.
capabilitySaveFailed: Capability policy could not be saved.
capabilityVersionConflict: This policy changed in another session. The latest version has been loaded; review and try again.
capabilityScopeLoadFailed: The capability scope could not be loaded.
capabilityWorkspaceRequired: Capability administration requires an active workspace.
capabilityReasonModelUnsupported: The model does not support this capability
capabilityReasonAgentVersionPolicy: Blocked by the published agent-version default
capabilityReasonOutsideLimit: The requested value was outside the policy limit
capabilityFlagAdminIntro: Release capabilities to this organization through versioned disabled, preview, or enabled states.
capabilityFlagPrecedenceNotice: Deployment and platform controls are absolute ceilings. Organization rollout flags cannot install a missing service, bypass a platform kill switch, grant resource access, or make an unsupported model capable.
capabilityFlagPlatformDisabledNotice: The platform has disabled this capability. Enabling it for the organization cannot override that decision.
capabilityFlagEnforcedNotice: This flag is connected to its runtime consumer and is enforced before external or durable side effects.
capabilityFlagReservedNotice: This is a rollout reservation. Saving it records future rollout intent but does not change current product behavior until its runtime consumer is connected.
capabilityFlagAllowlistDescription: Enter one subject per line as user:identifier or service_account:identifier. Subjects must belong to this organization.
capabilityFlagAllowlistInvalid: Use user:identifier or service_account:identifier on every non-empty line. Preview requires at least one subject.
capabilityFlagAllowlistDuplicate: Each preview subject may appear only once.
capabilityFlagAllowlistTooMany: A preview cohort may contain at most 100 subjects.
capabilityFlagReasonDescription: Required for the immutable change history and audit record. Do not include secrets or customer content.
capabilityFlagSaveFailed: The rollout state could not be saved.
capabilityFlagVersionConflict: This rollout flag changed in another session. The latest revision has been loaded; review it and try again.
capabilityFlagNoHistory: No organization revisions have been recorded.
capabilityReasoningPolicyDescription: Set restrictive reasoning ceilings for this organization or workspace.
capabilityReasoningPolicyRemediation: Lower scopes can only make these reasoning limits more restrictive. Raw hidden reasoning is never exposed.
capabilityReasoningAllowSummaryRetention: Allow provider-safe summary retention when the platform supports it
capabilityPreviewFailed: The policy preview could not be resolved.
